structured.approach: Read all step inputs, mainly task.components FC-1 to FC-10, feat.design B4 and feat.screens FS-1/FS-2. Checked the source and blast radius with the CodeGraph MCP tool (codegraph_explore) and the codegraph CLI. Implemented FC-1 to FC-7 as an additive change to src/ap_portal/index.js, leaving every existing line unchanged. Documented the change in README.md and a new docs/ap_portal.md. Ran node ci.mjs: the code compiles, the existing tests pass and the static checks are clean, but line coverage is below the gate of 90 because the new code's tests (FC-10) go in tests/, which is outside this step's write scope. That contradiction is raised as a BLOCKING question. The version step (FC-8/FC-9) is deferred because package.json is out of scope and no input gives the next version number.

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk(rows) is added and exported next to VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary; the existing exports are kept unchanged.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or []. It throws TypeError for a non-array rows value or a non-integer days value. Otherwise it renders <table class="overdue-risk"> with a plain header row Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount and one risk-classed row per input row, in the given order.
Amounts are checked against a decimal-string pattern and padded to two decimals as strings. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never used, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped for &, <, >, " and '. A risk value outside high, medium, low and unknown renders the class risk-unknown.
CodeGraph shows formatAmount has a single caller (renderAgingSummary) inside src/ap_portal/index.js. The new RISK_CLASSES and riskClass have no covering tests yet.
CI requires line coverage of src/** of at least 90. The existing tests do not call the new functions, so coverage stays below that gate until the FC-10 tests are added in tests/portal.test.js.
This step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md, so tests/portal.test.js (FC-10) and the package.json version (FC-9) were not changed.
VERSION stays '2.3.0' because no input gives the next version number and package.json must move together with it.
README.md now lists renderOverdueRisk, and docs/ap_portal.md documents its signature, the CT-1 inputs, the output, the errors and a synthetic example.

open_questions: BLOCKING: The CI coverage gate (line coverage of at least 90) cannot pass within this step's write scope, because the new code's tests (FC-10) belong in tests/portal.test.js, which this step may not change. Should this step be accepted with the coverage gate moved to the unit-test step, or should tests/portal.test.js be added to this step's scope? Owner: Developer (step owner).

Version step FC-8/FC-9 (DD-11): no input gives the next version number after 2.3.0, and package.json is outside this step's write scope. Who sets the number, and in which step do VERSION and package.json change together? Owner: Developer / Frontend lane.
Carried CQ-FE-1: should a missing or non-string id or vendor throw TypeError instead of rendering String(value)? Owner: Architect.
Carried CQ-FE-2: who styles overdue-risk and the risk-* classes, given that the design library defines no tokens? Owner: UX lead.

Documented it in README.md and docs/ap_portal.md. CI compiles, the existing tests pass and the static checks are clean, but line coverage is below the gate of 90 until the FC-10 tests exist in tests/, which is outside this step's scope. This is raised as a BLOCKING question to the step owner. The version step is deferred until someone confirms the version number and the package.json scope.
